caption:
The AI built the OTP screen with type="number". It looks right, and users still have to open Messages and copy the code by hand.

Look at the card. autocomplete="one-time-code" tells the browser this field wants a code from an SMS. Safari on iPhone uses it to show the code above the keyboard, one tap to fill. Without it, the browser has to guess.

type="number" is the wrong type anyway. It adds spinner arrows, accepts e and minus signs, and ignores maxLength. An OTP is a string of digits, not a number.

inputMode="numeric" still gives phones the digit keypad.

Source: MDN, HTML autocomplete attribute; MDN, input type="number".
